newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-LIETUVOS ENERGIA TO MAKE $75 MLN BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-LIETUVOS ENERGIA TO MAKE $75 MLN BOND ISSUE.

text.p: The shareholders meeting of state-owned Lithuanian energy company Lietuvos Energia has backed a suggestion by Merrill Lynch to issue $75 million of bonds, the company said on Friday.
Company deputy director Virgilius Vinciunas told Reuters that the funds will be used to buy fuel.
He said the fuel acquired would be nuclear fuel, heating oil and gas.

The deputy director said that the problems for the company were due in many cases to the difference between the price that consumers pay for energy and the actual production cost, which is susbstantially higher.
The government recently admitted that it owed the company some 776 million litas due to this price difference in 1994-1996.
The share capital of Lietuvos Energia is 2.8 billion litas.
Thye government has said it wants to sell the company but has given no timetable.
